card.name: Resuming or continuing after a missed dose
card.fires_on: Verbs like resume, continue, finish or resuming that start an instruction to carry on a regimen, plus linking words like before and and in timing instructions for doses or premedication.

modes.label: Resume or continue treatment
modes.description: A verb telling the reader to go on with dosing or treatment after a missed dose or a pause.
modes.example: If a dose is missed, advise patients not to take an extra dose.<< Resume>> treatment with the next dose.

modes.label: Timing words before or after a dose
modes.description: A linking word or space in instructions about what to do before or after a dose or infusion.
modes.example: Premedicate with a corticosteroid on the day prior to infusion<< and>> premedicate with a corticoster

card.writes: It seems to promote odd word pieces and to suppress adjustment and maintenance words, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on words that tell you to carry on with a dosing schedule, like resume or continue, and on timing words around doses.
